summary: The solver-visible sovereign-lb environment is a credible dual-language L4 load-balancer control and dataplane with 3,015 substantive reachable LOC (Go 1,434; C++/hpp 903; Python 265; fleet/scenario JSON 397). Entrypoints lb-control-plane, lb-dataplane, lbctl, and lab/backends trace through revision authority, canonical snapshot compilation, two-phase rollout quorum, framed control protocol, epoll TCP proxy with PROXY v2, checkpoint recovery, and health-aware eligibility/drain routing. Cross-module coupling is tight and partial fixes in one layer leave observable failures elsewhere; removing ~25% of core modules would collapse rollout, forwarding, or restart semantics rather than leaving a working toy.

evidence.observation: Advanced Systems task with go/cpp/bash/python tags, separate verifier, 8192MB memory, artifact /app/sovereign-lb, and 7200s agent timeout consistent with a large-system production package.
large_system_strict gate PASS with substantive_loc=3015, 29 interrelated defects across 7 root-cause clusters, 15 components, and no duplicated-environment-file inflation errors.

production-authenticity gate PASS with approved stateful-dataset exemption; domain state model covers revision authority, generation snapshots, rollout phases, dataplane runtime, health/drain, checkpoints, and 24-node fleet inventory.
Pinned ubuntu:24.04 base copies sovereign-lb, chmods bin/lab scripts, and runs bin/build to compile Go control plane and C++ dataplane before ENTRYPOINT lb-control-plane.
Primary runtime entrypoint opens durable state, serves framed node control on TCP :16081, and exposes management HTTP for apply/status/nodes/audit/ready/metrics.
Apply path validates desired config, enforces idempotency/revision authority, compiles canonical snapshots, persists generations, begins rollout, and dispatches prepare to connected node sessions.

Control stream accepts node hello, tracks session registry, records prepared/active/rejected envelopes into rollout coordinator, dispatches activate on quorum transition, and sets repository CURRENT on active phase.
Two-phase preparing/activating rollout with per-node session fences, quorum thresholds, deadline abort, mismatch rejection, and active-generation promotion logic.
Deterministic snapshot compilation with sorted listeners/targets, canonical JSON marshaling, and SHA-256 digest binding consumed by control plane and dataplane verification.

Dataplane entrypoint loads node config, restores checkpoint CURRENT with generation fallback, wires eligibility/health/drain/prober/proxy/status/control threads, and runs epoll event loop until shutdown.

Real epoll TCP proxy: listener reconcile, nonblocking accept/connect, PROXY protocol v2 header injection, bidirectional buffer transfer, idle/connect timeouts, and connection teardown with active-connection accounting.

Framed control client validates prepare digest/generation against canonical snapshot, saves checkpoints, prepares/activates runtime store, publishes listeners, and rejects invalid snapshots with coded responses.
Durable generation-scoped checkpoint directories with pending rename, digest verification, CURRENT pointer, and highest-generation fallback when CURRENT is corrupt or missing.
Fleet inventory loads and validates 24 per-node JSON profiles from config/nodes via inventory paths—config volume participates in multi-node lab orchestration rather than sitting unreachable.

Declares large_system_strict profile with substantive_runtime_loc 3015, Go control-plane modules (api, rollout, revision, snapshot, nodes, fleet, readiness, recovery, retention, catalog) and C++ dataplane modules (control, proxy, eligibility, selector, health, drain, checkpoint, protocol, status).

do_not_change: solver-visible environment/ tree scope hash binding
Go control-plane and C++ dataplane module split compiled by bin/build
two-phase rollout and canonical snapshot digest contract across control and dataplane

role_output.SUBSTANTIVE_LOC_ASSESSMENT: Validator substantive_loc=3015 across environment/ (Go 1434, C++ 568, hpp 335, Python 265, JSON 397, Dockerfile 16). Executable logic ~2618 LOC; remaining JSON is fleet node profiles and lab scenario desired state consumed by fleet loader, catalog, and dataplane --config startup. Largest modules (snapshot.cpp 200, api/control.go 130, prober.cpp 125, model.go 124, recovery/bootstrap.go 117) contain branching state/error behavior, not constant shells. Complexity validator reports no equivalent-file duplication groups.
role_output.MAJOR_MODULES: Go control plane: api (HTTP apply/status + framed control sessions), revision (idempotency and accepted-revision authority), snapshot (canonical compile/store/repository), rollout (prepare/activate quorum coordinator), nodes (session registry and stale-session rejection), fleet/inventory (24-node three-zone profiles), readiness (active-generation and connected-node checks), recovery (CURRENT/fallback bootstrap and corrupt pointer repair), retention (generation pruning bounds), catalog (scenario loading), model/validate (desired/snapshot schema), protocol (length-prefixed envelopes), metrics/audit (operator surfaces). C++ dataplane: control (prepare/activate/status client), proxy (epoll forwarding + PROXY v2), snapshot decode/runtime store, checkpoint (durable generation dirs + CURRENT), eligibility/health/drain/selector (target choice and zonal fail-open), prober (active health checks), protocol/json/sha256 (wire and canonical helpers), status (runtime observability). Lab: backends.py and fleet_simulator.py for loopback fleet exercise.
role_output.PARTIAL_FIX_TRAPS: Patching Go canonical JSON without matching C++ write_json/decode_snapshot breaks prepare digest verification; fixing rollout quorum without nodes session fences leaves stale prepared/active acknowledgements; activating generation in repository without dataplane checkpoint CURRENT desynchronizes restart recovery; eligibility-only fixes ignore drain deadlines and health ejection timers that proxy selection still consults; proxy listener reconcile without runtime prepare/activate leaves accepting on stale generations; recovery bootstrap that only repairs CURRENT without generation fallback misses corrupt-pointer scenarios; idempotency replay that skips rollout.Begin can accept revisions without reachable dataplane state.
role_output.REMOVAL_TEST: Removing proxy+connection+protocol (~200 LOC) eliminates real TCP forwarding and PROXY v2 behavior. Removing rollout+control dispatch (~250 LOC) collapses two-phase fleet rollout into immediate unsafe activation. Removing snapshot compiler/repository+revision (~220 LOC) removes config authority and idempotency. Removing checkpoint+recovery (~170 LOC) removes restart continuity after process crash or corrupt CURRENT. Any ~750 LOC (~25%) cut from these clusters leaves either a non-forwarding stub, a single-node toy without quorum semantics, or a control plane that cannot survive restart—none of which retain the stated production L4 scope.
